title: Copilot — Billing and Cost
description: AI credit spend, premium request usage, billing by model, org, and cost center. Powered by the GitHub Copilot exact-diff exporter billing family metrics.

options.content:
## Copilot Billing and Cost

This dashboard tracks GitHub Copilot AI credit and premium request consumption across the enterprise. Data is sourced from the billing APIs collected by the exact-diff exporter and written to VictoriaMetrics daily.

**Key concepts**
- **AI Credits** — the primary billing metric for Copilot premium model usage. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD.
- **Premium Requests** — the legacy billing metric, being phased out in favour of AI Credits.
- **Net Amount** — the amount after discounts. This is the figure that appears on your GitHub invoice.
- **Gross Amount** — the amount before any enterprise or negotiated discounts.

**Sections**
- **Spend Summary** — total net spend and credit consumption for the selected window
- **Spend Trends** — daily and cumulative billing over time
- **By Model** — which models are driving the most credit consumption
- **By Organisation** — cost allocation across orgs within the enterprise
- **Usage Summary** — broader enterprise billing across all GitHub products (if enabled)

**How to use:** Use the Billing Type filter to switch between AI Credits and Premium Requests. Use the Organisation filter to scope to a specific org. The time picker controls all panels.

panels.title: Total Net Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend in USD for the selected billing type and time window after enterprise discounts. This is the figure that appears on your GitHub invoice. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_amount_usd.

panels.title: Total Gross Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total gross spend in USD before discounts for the selected billing type and window. Compare to net amount to understand the value of enterprise discounts. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_gross_amount_usd.

panels.title: Total Discount Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total discount received in USD for the selected billing type and window. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_discount_amount_usd.

panels.title: Total Net Quantity
panels.description: Total quantity of billing units consumed (AI credits or premium requests) after discounts, for the selected window. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_quantity.

panels.title: Daily Net Spend Over Time (USD)
panels.description: Daily net spend in USD for the selected billing type. Spikes indicate days with heavy premium model usage. Use this to identify unusually expensive days and investigate which models or features drove the cost. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_amount_usd.

panels.title: Cumulative Net Spend Over Time (USD)
panels.description: Running total of net spend in USD over the selected window. Use this to track spend against monthly budget allocations and forecast end-of-month totals. Source: cumulative sum of github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_amount_usd.

panels.title: Net Spend by Model (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend broken down by model for the selected billing type and window. Identifies which models are the primary cost drivers. Premium models such as Claude Opus and GPT-4o consume the most per request. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_net_amount_usd grouped by model.

panels.title: Net Quantity by Model
panels.description: Total net quantity (credits or requests) consumed per model. Use alongside the spend chart to verify that quantity and spend are proportional — disproportionate spend on one model relative to quantity indicates a higher price per unit for that model. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_net_quantity grouped by model.

panels.title: Net Spend by Organisation (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend broken down by GitHub organisation within the enterprise. Useful for cost allocation and showback reporting to individual engineering teams. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_amount_usd grouped by org.

panels.title: Daily Spend by Organisation Over Time
panels.description: Daily net spend trend per organisation. Use this to spot which orgs are increasing spend over time and whether the growth is proportional to user count changes. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_total_net_amount_usd grouped by org over time.

panels.title: Billing Line Items
panels.description: Full billing line item detail for the selected billing type, showing model, SKU, unit type, gross quantity, discount, and net amount. Use this table for cost reconciliation against the GitHub invoice. Source: github_copilot_billing_{type}_* metrics at item level.

targets.expr: sum by (org, model, sku, unit_type) (increase(github_copilot_billing_${billing_family}_net_amount_usd{enterprise="$enterprise", schema_version="$schema_version", org=~"$org"}[$__range]))
sum by (org, model, sku, unit_type) (increase(github_copilot_billing_${billing_family}_net_quantity{enterprise="$enterprise", schema_version="$schema_version", org=~"$org"}[$__range]))
